# ONNX Runtime Web

Vendored from the npm package `onnxruntime-web@1.31.1`:
https://registry.npmjs.org/onnxruntime-web/-/onnxruntime-web-1.31.1.tgz

Only the WASM JavaScript entry point, SIMD/threaded loader, and corresponding
WASM binary are included. These files must be kept at matching versions.
Copyright Microsoft Corporation; MIT license in LICENSE, obtained from
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/v1.31.1/LICENSE.

Used by the extension's speech worker and the standalone speech feasibility probe.
